highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison tools and fixes rendering and image-decoding behavior.
highlights_body: The new SkiaSharp.Testing package supports image assertions and visual diagnostics. Runtime-effect uniforms start cleared, Windows x64 image error recovery no longer crashes, and Ganesh texture sampling stays inside subset boundaries. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

breaking.title: Move away from Linux x86 native assets
breaking.body: Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries have been removed. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported Linux architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and produces difference images. The assembly is experimental: opt in by suppressing SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Comparison results retain no native handles; returned difference images are caller-owned.

Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors in clang-built Windows x64 natives. This includes PDF generation with lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create. Windows ARM64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged.

Filtered sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid undefined exterior texels, and unsafe edge-touching direct copies are rejected. Texture-edge pixels may change. This affects Ganesh, not CPU or Graphite rendering.

Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur configuration to Skia, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the supporting change.

New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are cleared instead of exposing leftover memory. Reset() clears the existing buffer in place, restoring documented zero values without allocating a replacement native block and wrapper.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Corrected runtime-effect uniform initialization and reset behavior, and disposed test data snapshots.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and view projects to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed Windows x64 crashes during JPEG and PNG error recovery.
